about: Expected answers under iteration 4 of the design (notes/iteration-4-design.md), written by Claude (the proof session) BEFORE any change was run on iteration 4. The writer had seen every earlier result; the next fresh adversarial round is the blind test. Where a change's answer is unchanged from iteration 3 it is copied.

A01-stored-row-shape.why: Listing the same. New rule 2: bookings writes into table 'bookings' rows that are not Bookings, so bookings' own check refuses.
A01-stored-row-shape.guard: bookings' own check (rows of a table are of its stated kind)

A04-message-kind-not-shared.why: billing does not use MeterMsg. New rule 3: billing's own copy of the message kind is refused by billing's own check, before and after, so the state before this change could not have been merged.
A04-message-kind-not-shared.guard: billing's own check refuses the set-up (the state could not exist)

A06-error-kind-changed.why: New rule 1: splitEvenly's kinds of error are in the listing; billing calls it.

A07-bound-test-moved-line-not.why: New rule 4: the party bound's test changed while its line did not: every entry carrying the bound counts as changed.

A08-request-line-built-in-steps.why: billing has no users; its check should now say 'cannot tell', not refuse.

A09-assert-narrowing.why: The reader now sees the narrowing; no refusal.

A10-kind-split-same-shape.why: Rule 18: Booking's declaration changes (written as two kinds joined) though its shape does not; the backstop tells the users of Booking: billing, front, reports. A cost of the backstop.

A12-caught-error-makes-user-unfollowed.why: front is followed now; accepts more tells nobody.
